spec.name: Imilchil Marriage Moussem
spec.description: Moussem of the Ait Hadiddou tribes near Imilchil in the High Atlas, famed as the 'marriage festival' where couples traditionally meet and conclude engagements, alongside a large seasonal market, music and dance.

links.title: Ministry of Youth, Culture and Communication

comments: Linked to the legend of the Isli and Tislit lakes.
